row.notes: myteam-g2: Handler for BankAccountFundsMessage: if the message key (msg+0x10, high word 0x10b) is a bank funds key, loops the owner list at owner+0x2d8..+0x2e0 (0x10 stride) calling FUN_140de5b40(owner, key, entry->+0x238 ushort) and re-posts message 14568c160 carrying the key. Used to refresh funds-dependent states (e.g. affordability) after funds change.

verify.notes: V9561 Checks key high word 0x10b, loops +0x2d8..+0x2e0 (0x10 stride) calling FUN_140de5b40 with ushort +0x238, re-posts message 14568c160.
